messages:
matt (AE): Quick POC scoping thread — ACME wants a 4-week POC: semantic search + chat. Success criteria: ~95% rerank hit on eval set, median gen latency <200ms, cost target <$0.01/token. Need plan for SDK integration, auth (SAML/KMS), rate limits, streaming and retries. Elaine, can you confirm eval size and SSO requirements?

elaine (ACME): Dataset ~50k docs, ~10k eval prompts. We require SAML SSO + company KMS + per-user audit logs. Data residency EU only.

sanjay (SE): Got it. Proposed flow: embeddings -> ANN index -> reranker. We'll provide prompt templates and an eval harness. For scaling: dev API key with 500 req/s fine; production indexing spikes will need dedicated capacity. How tolerant on cache staleness?

matt (AE): ACME wants near-real-time updates, max 5 min staleness acceptable for most cases.

chloe (Eng): SDK + streaming notes: our JS/Python SDK supports streaming with on_chunk callbacks. Example (Python):
```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="${TOKEN}")
for chunk in client.stream("gpt-mini", prompt):
    process(chunk.text)
```
For auth: support Bearer tokens + mutual TLS for Private. For SAML we can issue scoped API keys after SSO.

ella (Security): SAML + KMS approach fine. We need SOC2 cert and an RSA-signed audit log export. Also want clarity on key rotation and HSM support.

sanjay (SE): For indexing durability: use bulk ingest with batch_size=512 and parallelism 8. Guideline: embedding endpoint throughput ~1200 tokens/s per GPU; suggest dedicated capacity for heavy indexing windows (2-6 hours). We'll file a request for reserved capacity during the index window.

elaine (ACME): We will consider committed usage for a 2x-V100 equivalent during indexing. Need pricing estimate and billing model (monthly vs committed).

matt (AE): I'll pull finance in. Ballpark for that tier is ~USD Xk/mo — will confirm exact quote today.

chloe (Eng): Retries + streaming behavior: for non-streaming requests use idempotency tokens (Idempotency-Key) and client exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 retries for transient 5xx. For streaming, recommend resume support: client sends resume_token + sequence offset; server will resume from KV cache if within retention window. Fallback policy: after 2 failed resume attempts, fall back to non-streaming full response.

matt (AE): Rate limits & quotas: we should provide ACME a dev key with 500 rps, and a prod quota plan: 5k rps soft, with autoscaling and overage alerts. Any objections?

sanjay (SE): Sounds good. We'll include a recommended quota table in the runbook and terraform snippet for KMS bindings. Also provide circuit-breaker suggestions: 30s open, 3 failures window.

elaine (ACME): Also need RBAC with per-user audit events and ability to rotate keys programmatically.

chloe (Eng): RBAC supported via team-scoped API keys + roles. We'll include example API and UI flows for key rotation and audit export.

matt (AE): Timeline proposal: week 1: integration + auth (SAML metadata + KMS), week 2: embeddings + index + smoke tests, week 3: evals & perf tuning, week 4: acceptance, handoff and runbook.

matt (AE): Action items — @sanjay: deliver eval harness + starter prompts by Tue; @chloe: streaming resume example + idempotency doc; @matt: formal pricing/contract; @elaine: share SAML metadata + KMS ARN. Check-ins Mon/Wed next week. :thumbsup:
